description.en: Accessible shadcn UI components beautifully animated with Motion and CSS.
description.zh: 为 shadcn/ui 组件注入细腻 Motion 动画的高无障碍动效增强库。

content.en: Animate UI is a curated extension of the shadcn/ui ecosystem focused on fluid, physics-based animations. Powered by Motion, it enriches standard shadcn components (dialogs, drawers, dropdowns, buttons) with natural easing curves and delightful micro-interactions without sacrificing accessibility.
content.zh: Animate UI 是一套专注于为 shadcn/ui 组件生态赋予物理动效生命的扩展库。依托 Motion 强大的弹簧动力学引擎，它在严格保留原始无障碍规范的前提下，为对话框、抽屉、下拉菜单与按钮等日常控件注入细腻灵动的缓动曲线与形变微动效。
